status: PROPOSED obligations, unexecuted; these cases do not prove implementation or acceptance.

scenarios.name: cross_uid_and_scope
scenarios.assertion: Authorize current reader identity before looking up snapshot/key; unauthorized and out-of-scope resources are indistinguishable.

scenarios.name: revoked_scope_between_pages
scenarios.assertion: Current read authority must still hold on each page; an old snapshot/cursor grants no authority.

scenarios.name: mixed_inventory_complete
scenarios.assertion: Enumerate scalar and aggregate registration rows under one observation; page without silent filtering or omissions.

scenarios.name: inventory_over_budget
scenarios.assertion: Return unavailable rather than truncate a page or silently exclude aggregate/archived/blocked registrations.

scenarios.name: latest_only_history
scenarios.assertion: A producer retaining only latest confirmed checkpoint reports latest_only and no fabricated events/times.

scenarios.name: pruned_history
scenarios.assertion: Retained history is explicit bounded coverage; collected/missing records cannot be reconstructed from Git reflog as confirmed service events.

scenarios.name: reused_key
scenarios.assertion: Bind bench ID as well as key; replacement registration cannot satisfy old snapshot requests.

scenarios.name: path_traversal
scenarios.assertion: Reject absolute, parent, empty component, backslash and .git control paths before filesystem reads.

scenarios.name: symlink_and_parent_race
scenarios.assertion: Use registered physical member roots and non-following descriptor-relative traversal; replaced parent/symlink refuses without following.

scenarios.name: backing_file_race
scenarios.assertion: Verify opened regular-file identity, size and bytes before/after bounded reads; detected mutation returns stale_snapshot without partial content.

scenarios.name: snapshot_not_fence
scenarios.assertion: Digest binds observed core and content manifest but never asserts all concurrent writers stopped or grants takeover.

scenarios.name: no_git_metadata_writes
scenarios.assertion: Do not invoke metadata-refreshing Git status or update index/worktree/cache/config while observing; read operations never migrate state.

scenarios.name: ignored_private_output
scenarios.assertion: Content scope covers explicitly authorized working files, including ignored/untracked when approved; default deny sensitive paths; no claim content is secret-free.

scenarios.name: binary_and_active_html
scenarios.assertion: Return bounded bytes with integrity digest and encoding; consumers render untrusted text without executing HTML, links, scripts or log escape sequences.

scenarios.name: diff_fixed_base
scenarios.assertion: Diff base identifies an authorized confirmed checkpoint/member vector; no arbitrary refs, revisions, pathspec expansion, commands or external tools.

scenarios.name: unsealed_log
scenarios.assertion: Report unsealed point-in-time bytes and unknown completeness/outcome; never upgrade to sealed or success from file presence or EOF.

scenarios.name: interrupted_absent_log
scenarios.assertion: Preserve absent capture as absent; do not synthesize empty file, known exit, complete capture or collection authority.

scenarios.name: collected_log
scenarios.assertion: Report collected metadata without reopening reused paths or recreating capture bytes.

scenarios.name: snapshot_expiry_and_retention
scenarios.assertion: Keep snapshot state bounded for at most five minutes; expiry/read retention does not delete engine checkpoints, logs, journals or receipts.

scenarios.name: network_gate
scenarios.assertion: No public listener or legacy Unix TCP proxy before accepted product audience/org/scope and key/host routing policy plus actual issuer provisioning.

scenarios.name: attach_and_takeover
scenarios.assertion: Read authority cannot attach stdin, execute commands, stop writers, acquire leases or adopt external writers; those require separate accepted contracts.

scenarios.name: consumer_conformance
scenarios.assertion: Run same shared corpus and actual authenticated bounded filesystem tests before enabling a consuming viewer; fixture rendering is not that evidence.
